about: Few-shot examples for generalize, sent as earlier user/assistant turns. Invented company (Orbitly), customers and values that are not in the Macrohard dataset pools. `document` carries the <gN> markers already; each example is rendered with user.md like a real request.

revenue-figures.name: Revenue figures
revenue-figures.description: Non-public revenue, bookings, margins or growth numbers.

internal-metrics.name: Internal metrics
internal-metrics.description: Non-public usage, adoption, churn or performance metrics.

deal-sizes.name: Deal sizes
deal-sizes.description: Contract values, renewals and pricing agreed with specific customers.

examples.document: Q3 update: revenue was <g1>$4.2M</g1>, up <g2>18%</g2> on Q2. Gross margin hit <g3>71%</g3>.
Pellham Freight renewed at <g1>€865k</g1> a year. Weekly active seats reached <g2>23,418</g2> and p95 latency is <g3>340 ms</g3>; churn fell to <g4>0.8%</g4>.
Closed-won: Dunmore Agri, <g1>$2.7M</g1> over two years. Adoption hit <g2>43.6%</g2> and the error rate peaked at <g3>87%</g3>. Bookings were <g4>$61.2M</g4>, up <g5>6.4%</g5>.
